QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` is the barrier. With assembly it is `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))`, so the compiler cannot see through the value.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the barrier preventing compiler visibility of the value, and it says the API definitions live in library/constant_time_impl.h. The location link is made through the earlier bullet and the asm/volatile-global description, not in the same sentence as the primitive.
